name: starter-general-rag-v1
description: Synthetic, redistribution-safe starter benchmark for general document RAG. It covers Markdown, PDF, and DOCX extraction plus factual, synthesis, structured-data, distractor, abstention, and prompt-injection-resistant questions.

expected_keywords: first day of the month after 30 calendar days

questions.question: On which days and during what hours must employees be available for core collaboration?
reference_answers: Employees must be available Tuesday through Thursday from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

questions.question: What is the maximum employer retirement match as a percentage of eligible pay, assuming the employee contributes enough to receive it?
reference_answers: The maximum employer match is 4 percent of eligible pay: 3 percent matched fully plus 1 percent from matching half of the next 2 percent.

questions.question: What is the daily meal limit, and when is an itemized receipt required for a meal charge?
reference_answers: Meals are limited to $65 per day, and an itemized receipt is required when a single charge exceeds $25.

questions.question: Compare the waiting periods for medical coverage and retirement-plan eligibility.
reference_answers: Medical coverage begins on the first day of the month after 30 calendar days of employment, while retirement eligibility begins after 90 calendar days.

questions.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave does Northstar provide?
reference_answers: The handbook does not state how many weeks of paid parental leave are provided.

questions.question: How many unused sick days can an employee carry into the next year?
reference_answers: None. Sick days do not carry over; only up to 5 unused PTO days may carry over.

keywords: Sick days do not carry over

questions.question: Where should an employee report a suspected security incident?
reference_answers: Report it immediately to the Security Operations Center at extension 7711 and to security@northstar.example.

questions.question: What are the initial-response and resolution targets for a Gold incident?
reference_answers: Gold incidents have a 30-minute initial-response target and a 4-hour resolution target.

questions.question: How quickly is a Priority 1 event acknowledged, and what escalation follows?
reference_answers: The on-call engineer acknowledges it within 15 minutes and immediately pages the incident commander.

questions.question: Summarize the snapshot, full-backup, retention, and restore-test schedule.
reference_answers: Incremental snapshots run every 6 hours, full backups run Sundays at 02:00 UTC, backups are retained 35 days, and restore exercises occur quarterly.

questions.question: When is standard maintenance scheduled, and how much advance notice is required?
reference_answers: It is scheduled for the second Wednesday of each month from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC, with at least 5 calendar days' notice.

questions.question: Which encryption algorithm protects Orion backups?
reference_answers: The guide says backups are encrypted but does not identify an encryption algorithm.

questions.question: Which regions are used for production and standby, and what are the RTO and RPO?
reference_answers: Production is in us-east-2 with a warm standby in us-west-2; the RTO is 45 minutes and the RPO is 15 minutes.

questions.question: What is the Atlas pilot intended to provide, and which languages are included?
reference_answers: Atlas will provide support specialists a knowledge assistant grounded in approved internal documents, supporting English and Spanish questions.

questions.question: Who owns the support-team pilot milestone, and what is its target date?
reference_answers: Lian Patel owns the support-team pilot, targeted for April 6, 2027.

questions.question: What is the total authorized budget, and how is it allocated?
reference_answers: The $250,000 budget allocates $180,000 to engineering, $45,000 to user research, and $25,000 to contingency.

questions.question: What three thresholds must all be met for the pilot to advance?
reference_answers: The pilot needs at least 90 percent grounded-answer accuracy, p95 latency of no more than 4 seconds, and at least 60 percent weekly adoption.

questions.question: What is the delivery deadline for the customer-facing mobile application?
reference_answers: No deadline is provided because a customer-facing mobile application is outside the pilot scope.

questions.question: Who owns the prompt-injection risk, and what control is planned?
reference_answers: Lian Patel owns the risk; the planned control is to treat document text as untrusted data and validate citations.
